tasks.subject: Task 0: Spike — minimal escaping coroutine (STOP-GATE)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Smallest escaping coroutine type-checks + runs under a synchronous resumer; resolve the host-op hook shape, the Future value representation, and the resume-vs-deep-re-install semantics (spec §5.2). STOP-GATE: if it forces a first-class Future, stop and surface.

**Files:** src/Wok/Interp/Machine.hs:157-201, src/Wok/Interp/Value.hs:48-77, /tmp/coro-spike.wok, spec §5.2.

**Verify:** cabal build && cabal run -v0 wok -- /tmp/coro-spike.wok --run -> 421

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/Machine.hs", "src/Wok/Interp/Value.hs", "docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-09-one-shot-escape-design.md"], "verifyCommand": "cabal build && cabal run -v0 wok -- /tmp/coro-spike.wok --run", "acceptanceCriteria": ["single-suspend/single-resume example types and runs to expected value", "resume re-establishes the coro handler", "§5.2 decision (single-shot vs chaining) written into spec", "STOP if first-class Future is forced"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Register the Future type
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Future a b r is a known built-in tycon (arity 3); signatures mentioning it type-check.

**Files:** src/Wok/TypeChecking/Builtins.hs, TyCon enum (TcFuture), src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs resolveTyCon, test/typecheck-examples/future-type-mentions.wok.

**Verify:** cabal test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Builtins.hs", "src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs", "test/typecheck-examples/future-type-mentions.wok"], "verifyCommand": "cabal run -v0 wok -- test/typecheck-examples/future-type-mentions.wok", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Future U64 U64 U64 signature type-checks", "Future has arity 3 / kind *->*->*->*"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Make Future second-class (carrier rule)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Future-typed bindings are second-class; returning/storing/listing -> CarrierEscape.

**Files:** src/Wok/TypeChecking/Carrier.hs (isHandleType ~292), test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-escapes-return.wok + .expected.

**Verify:** cabal test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Carrier.hs", "test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-escapes-return.wok", "test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-escapes-return.expected"], "verifyCommand": "cabal run -v0 wok -- test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-escapes-return.wok", "acceptanceCriteria": ["isHandleType (CTCon TcFuture _) = True", "function returning a Future -> CarrierEscape", "storing a Future in a constructor/list -> CarrierEscape"]}
```

**Files:** src/Wok/IR/Multiplicity.hs (~88), test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-await-twice.wok + .expected, test/run-examples/coro-escape.wok, test/golden/coro-escape.multiplicity.expected.

tasks.subject: Task 4: coro capability + passing examples
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Promote spike machinery to a clean with coro in / start/resume/value capability; single-shot (421) and fixed multi-driver (64) run via golden tests; resume re-establishes the capability; resume's row carries the tail's re-performed effects.

**Files:** src/Wok/Interp/Machine.hs, src/Wok/Interp/Value.hs, prelude/Std/Control.wok, src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs, test/run-examples/coro-multi-driver.wok, test/golden/{coro-escape,coro-multi-driver}.expected.

**Verify:** coro-escape.wok -> 421; coro-multi-driver.wok -> 64


tasks.subject: Task 5: Type resume-xor-cancel + unhandled-reperform negative
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A future is resume XOR cancel (<=1 total), typed now; a resumed tail re-performing an unhandled effect is a type error.

**Files:** src/Wok/IR/Multiplicity.hs, prelude/Std/Control.wok (cancel), src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs, test/typecheck-fail-examples/{future-resume-then-cancel,future-reperform-unhandled}.wok + .expected.

**Verify:** cabal test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/IR/Multiplicity.hs", "prelude/Std/Control.wok", "src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs", "test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-resume-then-cancel.wok", "test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-resume-then-cancel.expected", "test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-reperform-unhandled.wok", "test/typecheck-fail-examples/future-reperform-unhandled.expected"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["resume s v then cancel s -> MultishotResume", "tail re-performing an unhandled effect -> unhandled-effect type error"]}
```
